---
name: Skill bug
about: A skill did the wrong thing, or did not fire when it should have
title: "[bug] <skill>: <what went wrong>"
labels: bug
---

**Skill and version**
Which skill, and which release or commit.

**Agent**
Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Copilot, claude.ai, ChatGPT, or other. Include the version if you know it.

**What you ran**
The command or message. Use invented data only: an online shop or a subscription app. Do not paste real company names, table names or data.

**What happened**

**What you expected**
If you can, point to the line of the skill that says so.

**Which rule did it break?**
- [ ] Asked too many questions, or the same one twice
- [ ] Called a data tool before I named the source
- [ ] Used a name I did not say
- [ ] Claimed more than the method supports
- [ ] Skipped a rung of the validation ladder
- [ ] Did not offer the file at the end (chat app)
- [ ] Fired when it should not have, or did not fire
- [ ] Something else
